visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a man in his 30s wearing a black button-down shirt and black-rimmed glasses. He is positioned centrally against a digital backdrop showing a macro, blurred view of a spider's egg sac or nest structure. He is speaking energetically with wide-eyed expressions and active hand gestures. (2) A clear scientific image of a spider is presented; it displays a striking bilateral gynandromorph pattern where the left side is reddish-orange and the right side is dark grey/black. Labels 'A' and a '1 cm' scale bar are visible on the white background. (3) The man returns to the screen, continuing his presentation. He uses a handheld remote or clicker, moving his hands frequently to emphasize his points. The lighting is bright and professionally set, highlighting his facial features. (4) A split-screen graphic appears showing two spiders for comparison: the left image 'C' shows a greyish live specimen, and the right image 'A' shows the reddish-orange specimen. Text labels describe them as male and female types. (5) Back to the man, who is now explaining the internal anatomy. He gestures toward the camera as if explaining a complex concept. Yellow and white captions appear consistently at the bottom. (6) A technical diagram showing four scientific sections (A, B, C, D) of spider reproductive organs is displayed. The diagrams are labeled with '雌' (female) and '雌雄嵌合' (gynandromorph). (7) The man continues his talk, eventually putting on his glasses if they weren't on, or adjusting them. He moves closer to the camera for a more intimate, humorous delivery toward the end. (8) The final shots show him in a more relaxed, conversational manner, ending with a comedic back-and-forth reaction before the screen cuts.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: 頻道會員限定 晶片崛起搶先看. [Slogan]: 是男也是女！他是新蜘蛛樂園之王？. [Subtitle]: 厲害了 在新人類樂園. (2) [Subtitle]: 發現了雌雄一體的蜘蛛. (3) [Subtitle]: 我不是胡扯 因為科學家真的在泰國西部碧府. (4) [Subtitle]: 當鐘子超人 挖出這種全新的蜘蛛 研究剛刊登在《Zootaxa》期刊上. (5) [Subtitle]: 泰國朱拉隆功大學團隊 把這種從沒見過的蜘蛛命名為. (6) [Subtitle]: Damarchus inazuma. (7) [Subtitle]: Inazuma 這日文是 沒錯 就是我們偉大領袖 伊瓦柯夫的得力副手「雷電」. (8) [Subtitle]: 因為這隻蜘蛛真的一半男一半女. (9) [Subtitle]: 它是屬於 Bemmeridae 科 是一群在地底挖洞 守株待兔的穴居型蜘蛛. (10) [Subtitle]: 當然啦 這只是罕見的個體 不是每一隻 Inazuma 蜘蛛都長這樣. (11) [Subtitle]: 一般的雄蜘蛛大概 1.7 公分 全身灰白 覆著一層神秘白色粉末 像是上了粉底. (12) [Subtitle]: 雌蜘蛛體型更大 像是穿著亮橘色外套的辣妹. (13) [Subtitle]: 但這次挖到的樣本裡 科學家看到一隻左邊橘紅 長得像雌蜘蛛 右邊灰白 長得像雄蜘蛛 一條中線乾淨俐落 像拿尺畫的. (14) [Subtitle]: 這老實說 更像是阿修羅男爵. [Variety]: 蛤 不認識. (15) [Subtitle]: 這不是什麼性別流動 而是貨真價實的「雌雄嵌合」gynandromorph. (16) [Subtitle]: 它的身體左右兩半 是兩種性別硬生生拼在一起的. (17) [Subtitle]: 這種現象在蜘蛛界堪稱傳說級 SSR 整個原蛛亞目裡 是有紀錄以來的第三隻. (18) [Subtitle]: 那科學家怎麼確定的 不是只看顏色那麼膚淺 而是拿立體顯微鏡觀察蜘蛛的腳爪. (19) [Subtitle]: 結果右邊雄性那側 有一排性感的「S 型曲線」齒列 左邊雌性那側 則是兩排規矩的齒列表 是一個關鍵證據. (20) [Subtitle]: 接著直接解剖看內在 果然只有左半邊體內有雌性的內生殖器官「受精囊」 右半邊完全沒有. (21) [Subtitle]: 這下板上釘釘 兩性差異明顯 是典型的「兩性異形」物種. (22) [SubtitleSubtitle]: 而這隻嵌合體就這樣 完美融合在同一個身體裡. (23) [Subtitle]: 就是因為這隻特殊個體 研究團隊乾脆正式命名這個物種為「Damarchus inazuma」. (24) [Subtitle]: 論文裡寫明命名靈感來自《One Piece》裡能變換性別 左右顏色不同的「雷電 Inazuma」. (25) [Subtitle]: 實在太宅了. (26) [Subtitle]: 不過這發現真的有學術意義 雌雄嵌合提供了研究性別決定 與胚胎發育的重要線索. (27) [Subtitle]: 也讓我們看到大自然 偶爾會自己出 Bug 而這次 Bug 還真的出在 Bug 上 結果美得像藝術. (28) [Subtitle]: 蛤 被這種蜘蛛咬會變成新人類嗎 你試啊 啊是要我試啊. [Variety]: Fuck.
